messages:
nina: Heads-up: deploy-bot paused the canary promotion for release `release-2026-03-21` because the image push step to the registry failed in CI.
deploy-bot: Promotion paused: job `ci/publish/registry-push` failed with manifest upload error. Full log: https://ci.internal/redwood/1768754322
corey: Key error from the build logs:
```
[2026-03-21T14:02:04Z] pushing layer 3/5 to registry.example.com/redwood/backend:sha256:...
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
{"error": "manifest upload failed: checksum mismatch: expected md5=Q2hlY2s= but received md5=SGFzaA=="}
ERROR: push failed: artifact integrity validation failed
```
rahul: We recently turned on "optimize-upload: gzip" in the artifact uploader to save bandwidth. Looks like some runners gzip at source and the uploader double-compresses, which changes calculated checksums.
leo: I can repro locally: when the client gzips before sending and the uploader adds gzip again, registry calculates md5 for the raw stream and it doesn't match the provided header. Registry rejects the manifest.
nina: Change window is open. Proposal: revert the optimize-upload change in the publish step to restore the pre-change behavior and unblock the canary. We'll follow up with a fix to make the uploader checksum calculation robust.
deploy-bot: Manual rollback of pipeline config allowed. Automatic promotion remains blocked until a successful publish and manual promote.
corey: I'll open a small change to the CI pipeline to disable gzip optimization (PR includes explanation and rollback plan).
deploy-bot: PR #5533 opened: ci/publish - disable optimize-upload gzip. CI triggered.
deploy-bot: CI for PR #5533 completed: status=success (publish step succeeded, registry accepted manifest).
rahul: Nice. That matches my local repro. We also need to add an integration test that verifies manifest acceptance after upload.
ops-bot: Note: please add a follow-up ticket RW-3751 for uploader checksum hardening and an integration test covering pre-compressed inputs.
nina: Requesting manual promote now that publish succeeded.
nina: /promote release-2026-03-21 --manual
deploy-bot: Promotion request recorded. Required approvals: eng-releases (corey), eng-sre (leo).
corey: Approved.
leo: Approved.
deploy-bot: Promotion started: canary rollout 0% -> 10% -> 40% -> 100%. Healthchecks passed at each stage. Promotion complete.
nina: Release unblocked. Adding a short release note: "Temporarily reverted upload gzip optimization after registry manifest checksum mismatch during CI publish; uploader checksum logic to be hardened (RW-3751)."
rahul: I'll own the follow-up and add the integration test to the CI matrix so this doesn't regress.
corey: Thanks all for quick response. Closing thread.
